sentences: Savitch's theorem simulates nondeterministic space s using deterministic space roughly s squared.
The source proposes exploiting the tree-shaped structure of the simulation together with improved tree-evaluation algorithms.
The target is any asymptotic improvement to little-o of the squared-space bound.
Its suggested route trades circuit height against larger intermediate alphabets.
The project seeks to reduce the memory cost of coordinating recursive reachability checks, improving a general simulation theorem rather than solving one special graph class.
